primary_target_policy: unchanged v1 15-minute TTL, fixed monthly discovery roster and 25% known sensor-time threshold
primary_selection_objective: pooled chronological validation mean squared error; report RMSE, R2 and MAE
probability_selection_objective: unmetered suitability unavailable; metered panel binary head uses Brier separately
legacy_test_status: already inspected; diagnostic benchmark only; never select models on its results

new_archive_holdout.status: reserved before acquisition/selection; do not open outcomes during development
new_archive_holdout.evaluation_requires: a later explicit locked run after all model/feature choices are frozen

prospective_manual_holdout.status: planned, not observed; reserve entire new blocks plus later sessions before fitting

test_row_selection: exact frozen v1 target row identities and values; no filtering based on new features or errors
